Video Compressor for Discord 10MB — Initial Release

- Compresses MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM videos up to 500MB to meet Discord's 10MB upload limit, with fast cloud GPU processing.
- Simple upload, compress, and export workflow; outputs 720p MP4 files suitable for Discord.
- Auto handles backend connection and session management via NEMO tokens (supports free anonymous usage).
- Supports file uploads, aspect ratio changes, text overlays, and audio tracks via chat commands.
- Error handling guides users in case of common issues like unsupported formats, file size, or credits.
- Clear chat prompts for preview, export, and video edits; provides tips for best results.
